mentions.name: Simple CRM
mentions.description: This project is a deliberately simple CRM, built on the premise that 90% of companies only need something basic rather than a complex, heavily customized CRM or ERP.
mentions.problem: Existing CRM and ERP products are bloated and painful; 90% of companies only need something simple.
mentions.audience: Companies that need something simpler than existing CRM and ERP suites.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building this right now! I've helped several companies implement CRMs and worked on heavily customizing my ERP at work. They all suck, bad. 90% of companies only need something simple.

evidence.value: Building this right now! I've helped several companies implement CRMs and worked on heavily customizing my ERP at work. They all suck, bad. 90% of companies only need something simple.
